name: Kyotojin no Hisokana Tanoshimi Rouge: Keisho
original_name: 京都人の密かな愉しみ Rouge-継承-
overview: After years in Paris, former wagashi heiress Miyako Sawafuji returns as illness threatens her Kyoto family. Between centuries-old tradition and modern ambitions, a new generation faces whether and how to inherit the shop and its culture.
